answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 31253 Country: United Kingdom Title: Wife is pregnant Question: my wife is pregnant i am looking for dua to dum on her stomach. Answer ID: 31253 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 536/L=133/t=1432) Recite surah Yasin and blow it on the water and give your wife to drink, also put its splashes on your wife's stomach, in-sha-Allah, your wife and the child shall be fine. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
